name: City of San Diego
disclaimer: Verify with the City of San Diego Development Services Department. Active ADU ordinance revisions are frequent.

detached.max_height_ft_note: San Diego allows up to 24 ft for detached ADU with a habitable attic space; standard 2-story limit 20 ft; 1-story 16 ft.
notes: City of San Diego has one of the most ADU-permissive ordinances in California.
Up to 4 ADUs possible on some lots under City's multi-unit ADU rules.
Coastal Overlay zones require CDP — verify at City Planning or CA Coastal Commission.
City has its own ADU pre-approved plan program (Companion Unit program).
Height up to 24 ft allowed for 2-story detached ADU per SDMC §141.0302.
